youtube_title: Debugging Async Systems with Evidence | CS 5254 Week 11
summary: A synchronous workflow moves into background workers, so correctness now depends on events, retries, ordering, and observability across time.
youtube_description:
A synchronous workflow moves into background workers, so correctness now depends on events, retries, ordering, and observability across time. The lecture focuses on correlation IDs, state snapshots, and traces as the basis for debugging async behavior.

This CS 5254 Week 11 lecture explores debugging async systems and its impact on concurrent system design.
